description: Context Bridge provides persistent project state for AI-assisted work. It helps users create and retrieve project state, record decisions, tasks and events, create checkpoints, compare snapshots, preview potential merges, preserve source provenance, search project history, and resynchronize project state across work sessions.

defaultPrompt: Create a new Context Bridge project for this work and initialize its current project state.
Restore my Context Bridge project state and summarize key decisions, active tasks, recent events, and what I should do next.
Create a checkpoint of my current Context Bridge project state so I can safely continue this work in another session.
